summary: Through road with no parking and no cars along the park-side kerb.

best_section.where: Park-side kerb beside the ball field, before the junction

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto open parkland and ball field, but homes sit 15-25 m away at both ends.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is on the lane edge with no verge or bay to pull out of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Tertiary 60 km/h link road meeting a busy signalled junction.
drivers.convention: OSM has parking:both no and no parked cars seen along this kerb.
